flows.name: Welcome Player
script: kick $player Name must not be Survivor

flows.name: MOTD
script: say -1 Admins are active, please play respectfully.
say -1 If you need admin assistance, send a message in game.

flows.name: Server restart
script: $warn | say -1 Server is going to restart in @minutes minutes!
say -1 Server is going down for a restart, you will be kicked!
cancel: say -1 Server restart has been cancelled.
